decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program is highly related to the firm's existing mental health and therapeutic expertise, and with its own R&D and specialist teams the firm is well placed to learn from the first year and improve it commercially.

The carpentry workshop fits the firm's practical therapy and production capabilities and can be refined through the firm's existing know-how in supported work settings, so it is worth developing further rather than exiting after only one year.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's established support services, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to interpret early demand and integrate the service into its broader care pathways.
Counseling for senior living closely complements the firm's eldercare activities and network of facilities, making it a natural extension that the firm can quickly absorb, coordinate, and scale.

The retail shop extends the sheltered workshop logic into market-facing sales while drawing on the firm's existing production and inclusion knowledge, so management would likely keep it to build learning and participation benefits.
